firm_data.firm_description: Davidoff Hutcher & Citron is a leading law and government relations law firm with highly distinguished lawyers in the New York City, Albany, and Washington, D.C. areas. The firm's diverse and sophisticated practice includes all aspects of business law, commercial litigation, real estate, land use, matrimonial, bankruptcy, trusts and estates and administrative law.
notable_facts: Offices in New York City, Washington D.C., Albany, White Plains, and Palm Beach

email.subject: AI for Davidoff Hutcher & Citron, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi there,

Davidoff Hutcher & Citron has built a sophisticated practice across commercial litigation, real estate, and business law since 1975, spanning New York, D.C., and Albany. That kind of geographic and practice diversity creates real operational complexity.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of regional practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
